title: 第314章 番外顶级二代第313章 番外昏君之间亦有差别
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
“这跟皇朝有什么关系？”
太白有些错愕。
“宋朝是个废物皇朝。”
“风气保守，理学兴盛，观念愈发守旧。”
“所以，嫡长子天然会在这种风气下占据优势。”
韦皋这时也平静开口了。
武穆之中的情况，是被外邦铁蹄蹂躏过的天下。
女子需要担心不知何时南下的蛮夷，将她们掳掠而去，强暴凌辱。
男子则需要担心大军南下，大军残杀乃至折磨他们。
这种情况下，没有南北朝乞活军那股血性，反而愈发保守。
在惯性之下，后世风气必然愈发倒退。
在南北朝，能力不行就滚下去，让行的上。
只要你行，那大伙就拥护你。
但在明这种情况下，嫡系就是高人一等。
“不单单是如此，影像一开始就说了，太祖的祖训定死了，有嫡立嫡，无嫡立长。”
“加之成祖奉天靖难，优待宗室。”
“这个优待，怕是不会简单。”
“宗室本身就是一股强大的力量，旁系终究是旁支，嫡系间彼此抱团，会有更大的力量。”
“更别提后宫实际上还掌握在堡宗母亲手上了。”
“景泰的位置，没有看到的那么稳。”

韦皋说出了的自己的看法。
不过他以为成祖的优待是类似西晋亲王那般的巨大权力。
但没曾想，成祖的优待居然是养猪。
不过这也造成了一个后果，那就是宗室们虽然没有其他任何权力，但有最基本的富贵。
因而，他们反而比其他人更厌恶变化。
皇帝只需要在嫡系这一脉传下去就好了，任何变化都可能导致自身待遇下降。
除非没有别的办法，否则他们天然就是嫡系拥趸。
“景泰不过就是个背锅的，没干好要被史书骂，至于干好了？”
“活干完了就该滚了。”
“要是他手腕不够，很可能被赶下去。”
李必接话，说出最致命的一点。
“你们玩权谋的，心眼都这么多？”
太白眼神清澈了。
他只看到景泰干的好好的，屁股刚坐热没多久就要被赶下去。
但按照他们说的，景泰根本没坐稳皇位，只不过是个干活的？
“是你太直。”
李必笑笑，他也挺像和太白一样的。
content_en:
"What does this have to do with the dynasty?"
Taibai was a little stunned.
"The Song Dynasty was a waste dynasty."
"The atmosphere is conservative, Neo-Confucianism is flourishing, and ideas are becoming more conservative."
"So, the eldest son will naturally have an advantage in this kind of culture."
Wei Gao also spoke calmly at this time.
The situation in Wu Mu is that of a world that has been ravaged by the iron hoofs of foreign countries.
Women need to worry about the barbarians who will come south at some point, kidnap them, and rape and humiliate them.
Men need to worry about the army going south, killing and even torturing them.
Under this circumstance, they did not have the bloody spirit of the beggar armies of the Northern and Southern Dynasties, but became more conservative.
Under inertia, the trend of later generations will inevitably become more and more retrograde.
In the Northern and Southern Dynasties, if you can't do it, get out and give way to those who can.
As long as you can do it, everyone will support you.
But in a situation like Ming's, the direct descendants are superior to others.
"Not only that, the video said it at the beginning, Taizu's ancestral precepts are dead, there is a direct descendant, there is no direct descendant."
"In addition, Chengzu Fengtian Jingnan gave preferential treatment to the clan."
"I'm afraid this preferential treatment won't be easy."
"The clan itself is a powerful force, and the collateral clans are only collateral clans after all. If the direct clans stick together, they will have greater power."
"Not to mention that the harem is actually in the hands of Baozong's mother."
"Jingtai's position is not as stable as seen."
Wei Gao expressed his opinion.
However, he thought that Chengzu's preferential treatment was a huge power similar to that of the prince of the Western Jin Dynasty.
But I never thought that Chengzu’s preferential treatment was to raise pigs.
However, this also has a consequence, that is, although the clan members do not have any other power, they have the most basic wealth.
As a result, they are more averse to change than others.
The emperor only needs to pass it on in the direct line. Any changes may lead to a decrease in his own treatment.
Unless there is no other way, they are naturally direct supporters.
"Jingtai is just a scapegoat. If he doesn't do it well, he will be scolded by the history books. As for if he does it well?"
"When the work is done, it's time to get out."
"If he is not smart enough, he may be kicked off."
Li Bi answered and told the most fatal point.
"You guys are so Machiavellian, do you have so many evil intentions?"
Taibai's eyes are clear.
All he saw was that Jingtai was doing a good job and was about to be kicked off soon after his butt got hot.
But according to what they said, Jingtai didn't secure the throne at all, he was just a worker?
"You are too straight."
Li Bi smiled, he looked just like Taibai.
